verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents automations that integrate with GitHub, Linear and Slack and can run on webhook events (gh-4). Its templates show event-driven patterns: opening a conversation from a Slack mention with the message context, reviewing PRs when a label is applied, and turning failed workflows or security alerts into fix PRs. These imply an issue-to-agent workflow could be built, but no evidence shows a first-class flow for assigning or labeling an existing issue or ticket so the agent implements it (the incident template only triages and routes issues). missing for 10: documented direct issue/ticket-to-agent assignment (e.g., issue label or mention triggering a coding run), a Linear/Jira ticket-to-PR flow, hands-on or independent corroboration.
